newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chubu Electric's Kawagoe plant boosts capacity.
newsitem.headline: Chubu Electric's Kawagoe plant boosts capacity.

text.p: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc said on Tuesday that operating capacity at the fourth plant of its Kawagoe thermal power complex in Mie prefecture, central Japan, had risen to 729,000 kilowatts (kw).
The new plant lifts Chubu Electric's total power generation capacity to 30.2 million kw, a company spokesman said.
The fourth plant's second and third power units began operating on August 1, he said.

The capacity of the fourth plant, a liquefied natural gas thermal power plant, will increase to about 1.65 million kw around the end of the year, when all seven of its planned power units are scheduled to be in commercial operation, the spokesman said.
